messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - gpu-host kernel panic detected on rust-gpu-node-07 - auto-page to oncall
PagerDuty: Alert details -> service: gpu-host-health, symptom: kernel_panic, severity: high, node: rust-gpu-node-07
Sam (oncall): acked. pulling up node status and recent alerts
Sam (oncall): `kubectl get nodes rust-gpu-node-07 -o wide` -> STATUS: NotReady, AGE: 32d, LAST_HEARTBEAT: 21s ago
Ingrid (infra): on standby. can you attach serial console logs? I'll prepare cordon/drain if kernel panic confirmed
Sam (oncall): grabbing syslogs now. excerpt from `journalctl -k -b -1 | tail -n 40`:
```
[    7.234567] NMI: CPU0: Lockup - not syncing
[    7.234789] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
[    7.235000] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[    7.235222] Call Trace:
    ...
```
Sam (oncall): confirmed kernel panic in previous boot. cordon/drain plan: cordon, drain with ignore-daemonsets and delete-emptydir-data
Sam (oncall): `kubectl cordon rust-gpu-node-07` -> node cordoned
Sam (oncall): `kubectl drain rust-gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` -> eviction in progress, most pods rescheduling
Ryan (sre): observing reschedule of redwood-inference-serving-prod pods. scaling warm pool on rust-gpu-node-11 to pick up traffic.
Maria (support): telemetry shows a spike in 503s for /v1/generate for model `gptx-8b` in us-west-2 between +00:12 and +00:25 UTC. Customer tickets opened: #12345, #12346. Impact: increased latency and occasional 503s for heavy multimodal requests.
Kevin (platform): routing policy has auto-failed over ~37% of traffic from rust-gpu-rack-3 to fallback pool (us-west-2-b) and cheaper-variant model. Fallback applied to avoid broader SLA breach.
Ingrid (infra): checking hardware: dmesg shows NVMe controller reset errors and multiple device disconnects. vendor likely hardware fault. I've opened vendor case HWC-98321 and attached serial console logs.
Sam (oncall): post-drain checks: control plane pods healthy; user-facing pods rescheduled to rust-gpu-node-09 and rust-gpu-node-11. latency trending back down but >baseline for large models.
Deploy Bot: Canary routing change applied for /v1/generate -> model `gptx-8b-fallback` (traffic=37%). Monitoring metrics for error rate and latency.
Ryan (sre): attempted kubelet restart on rust-gpu-node-07: `systemctl start kubelet` -> failed. kubelet logs indicate missing nvidia module on boot path and cgroup errors.
Ingrid (infra): marking node for rebuild. Will preserve /var/crash and capture kdump before reprovision. Scheduling maintenance window at 23:00 UTC to reprovision rust-gpu-node-07 with new firmware and vendor tech on remote console.
Maria (support): drafting customer status update: "We've mitigated routing and traffic fallback to reduce impact. Some customers may see degraded performance for large models. No data loss. We're rebuilding a failed GPU host and expect resolution within the maintenance window." Sending to legal/comms for signoff.
Sam (oncall): handing incident to @Ingrid (infra) for hardware rebuild and vendor coordination. I'll remain on-call for the postmortem and follow-ups. Tagging this as Sev2 and creating incident doc.
Ingrid (infra): taking lead. Next immediate steps: capture kdump, preserve /var/crash, run full NVMe SMART and firmware dump, vendor remote-console session started.
Sam (oncall): thanks all. closing this page — will reopen or escalate if kubelet recovers or if further customer impact arises. :thumbsup:
